mapper.sql: u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.phone, u.avatar, u.status, u.create_time, u.update_time, (select count(*) from mall_order o where o.user_id = u.id) as order_count, (select count(*) from mall_order o where o.user_id = u.id and o.pay_status = 'PAID') as paid_order_count, (select coalesce(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) from mall_order o where o.user_id = u.id and o.pay_status = 'PAID') as total_spent, (select count(*) from mall_review r where r.user_id = u.id) as review_count, (select max(o.pay_time) from mall_order o where o.user_id = u.id) as last_order_time
mapper.select:
select from sys_user u
and (u.username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and u.status = #{status}
order by u.create_time desc, u.id desc
select count(*) from sys_user where id = #{id}
